newsitem.title: USA: VSI Enterprises to abandon stock split.
newsitem.headline: VSI Enterprises to abandon stock split.

text.p: Network multimedia company VSI Enterprises Inc said Monday its board of directors voted to abandon a proxy proposal for a reverse one-for-two stock split.
The company said its shareholders had decided against the reverse split.
"In this instance, we believe ...that the key to increasing shareholder value is for VSI to improve its performance," it said.
The company said it was the second time that it had decided not to go ahead with such plans.
In March 1996, VSI abandoned plans for a one-for-two reserve stock split of common stock authorized by its shareholders at a June 1995 annual meeting.
